Test OpenArticle

These are fictional local news pages. Load the extension’s dist folder at chrome://extensions, pin OpenArticle, then open a page below and click its toolbar icon.

Test pageExpected statusReader
Public articleFree articleEnabled
Authorized syndicated copyFree articleEnabled
Subscription overlayHard paywallDisabled
Restricted publisher metadataHard paywallDisabled
Sign-in messagePossible soft paywallDisabled
Incomplete articlePossible soft paywallDisabled
Nonarticle pageUnknownDisabled

Check the public article

  1. Click Read Article: headings and paragraphs should appear; hidden draft text should not.
  2. Click Load article images: the garden illustration should appear.
  3. Try A+, A− and the theme button. Scroll to the bottom: progress should reach 100%.
  4. Open the original publisher link: the original page should remain unchanged.
  5. Reopen the extension and click Find Free Version: three search links should appear, clearly marked unverified.

The fictional article will not have a real syndicated search match. For a real-world check, try a public NASA news article or a publisher page that explicitly states a Creative Commons republication license. Detection is heuristic.
